connectingThread: Grand strategy supplies the horizon; intelligence supplies the understanding of terrain. Together they are the enabling prior conditions of offense — know where you are going (grand strategy) and know what the environment actually is (intelligence).
priorChapterRelationship: Ch3 established the discipline of declining fights; Ch4 established the discipline of using fights on favorable terms. Ch5 shifts to the enabling conditions of offense: the long-horizon anchor (grand strategy) and the opponent model (intelligence) that make offensive moves rational rather than merely aggressive.

reversalFlags.grand_strategy: Rigidly held becomes inflexibility when world has changed; must distinguish rationalized drift from genuine required revision.
reversalFlags.intelligence: Can become substitute for action; the operator who needs perfect information forever is paralyzed — the information threshold must be recognized and honored.
